_comment: Design guidance: the program's app management policy as reviewed data (Chapter 04; Book 04, Chapter 05, 'Enforcing the order with app management policies'). Microsoft's recommended settings: new client secrets and symmetric keys blocked, certificates capped at 180 days, for apps created after the effective date; the same restrictions on application and service principal objects, so the admin center can still edit them. Exceptions are app management policies with a record and an end date. The lock applies to every app registration in Chapter 01's register. Change this file only in a reviewed pull request; each run records its SHA-256.

exceptions.name: Mail Automation
exceptions.description: Mail Automation can't use a certificate until its vendor's next release. Secrets stay allowed, capped at 30 days, until 2027-01-31 (record EXC-NPI-0001).
